title: Vanishing ideal and reduced induced closed subscheme
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and $T\subseteq X$ a closed subset. Its vanishing ideal sheaf $\mathcal I_T$ is the quasi-coherent ideal sheaf [def-sbc-ideal-sheaf-powers] defined on every affine open $U=\operatorname{Spec}R\subseteq X$ [def-weil-affine-spectrum] by $\mathcal I_T(U)=\bigcap_{\mathfrak p\in T\cap U}\mathfrak p\subseteq R$, where points of $U$ are identified with prime ideals of $R$. The reduced induced closed subscheme on $T$ is, by definition, the closed subscheme cut out by $\mathcal I_T$, with its canonical inclusion into $X$, using the ideal-sheaf subscheme construction [def-weil-pbc-scheme-reduction].
